verdict.rationale: Ollama documents a one-line install script (`curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh`) on its download page, and community reports confirm downloadable desktop apps for macOS and Windows plus prebuilt ROCm containers, so no source compilation is needed. Users also describe setup as taking a couple of clicks. missing for 10: first-party documentation of OS package-manager packages (e.g. Homebrew/apt) and explicit per-platform installer/binary listings, deeper first-party detail on the Windows/macOS installers and container images
